t: They watered their land with thick,
in order that it might become good.
(namely, a thing, JK, or an affair, S and K,)
firm, stable, strong, solid, compact, sound,
imperfection, by the exercise of skill; he made it firmly, strongly, solidly, compactly, so that it was firmly and closely joined
knit together, soundly, thoroughly, skilfully, judiciously,
well; he so constructed, constituted, established, settled, arranged, did, performed,
executed, it; he put it into a firm, solid, sound,
possessed, the skill requisite for it;
Who hath created everything firmly, strongly, solidly,
disposed it, in the fit, proper,
in a rivulet or in the channel of a torrent,
thick matter that is borne by it
and that sinks to the bottom; used for improving land
of the channel of a torrent;
accord. to the Jámi' of El-Ghooree. (Mgh.) ― -b2-

maqayis: التاء والقاف والنون أصلان: أحدهما إحكام الشيء، والثاني الطين والحمأة.
فالقول الأول أتقنت الشيء أحكمته. ورجل تقن: حاذق. وابن تقن: رجل كان جيد الرمي يضرب به المثل. قال: يرمي بها أرمى من ابن تقن وأما الحمأة والطين فيقال: تقنوا أرضهم، إذا أصلحوها بذلك، وذلك هو التقن.
